'''1M-AU5''' was the designation of a golden [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 series repair droid]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWA" /> As a [[MSE-series]] [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repair droid]], it was produced by the company [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni]], and like all units of the MSE-6 it stood twenty-five [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] tall.<ref name="NEGTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
1M-AU5 was a companion droid available in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] which was released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]. The droid was rewarded to the first one million players who registered in the game, and was unavailable in any form afterwards. As 1M-AU5 was an optional companion, this article makes no assumption about if any character owned it.
